metadata.description: Apogee — personal fork of the Claude Code Development Kit (CCDK). Per-project install of the workflow machinery (durable docs context, br issue memory, git-flow and idea-mcp conventions, two safety hooks) plus the prime/plan/run-plan/merge/release commands and the docs/apogee doc loop.

plugins.name: apogee
plugins.description: Claude Code workflow machinery: lifecycle hooks (secret scan + release ASK, plus context injectors), workflow skills (update-docs, review-work, second-opinion, deploy, doc, readme, image-*, br, git-commit, git-flow, idea-mcp), and the init/prime/plan-feature/release/merge commands. Install once, enable per project.
